text: Added Perfs to the 23 Sand existing perforations.  New added perfs are from 10,482'-10510'MD / 8,995'-9,013' TVD.  Isolated Completion 1 of 4, added Completion 1 of 5 to capture added perforations, Completion number remains S03.

Rigged up the Pride 1502 rig on slot 7 EB 161 A-13.  TIH w/ 13-1/2" directional BHA, washed out the drive pipe with 8.6 ppg seawater and surveyed.  Directionally drilled w/ 13-1/2" BHA to 2,890' MD.  Ran and cemented 11-3/4" casing.  Installed 11-3/4" wellhead.  NU and tested 13-5/8" 10M BOPE, and Weatherford?s RCH.  TIH w/ 9-7/8? directional BHA.  Displace seawater to 10.8 ppg SBM and drilled out shoe track and 10? of new formation and ran LOT to 11.9 ppg.  Slide drilled to 5,964' MD.  Ran 7-3/4" casing tagging up at 5,219? MD.  Unable to get deeper.  Cemented in place in 2 stages with the ICP/stage collar and set on back-ups slips in the wellhead at the surface.  P/U 6-1/2? x 7-1/2" BHA and drilled out cement and 10? new formation and ran LOT to 13.6 ppg which was not sufficient to get to TD.  Performed first EZ Squeeze at the 7-3/4? casing shoe.  Drilled to 6,162? MD and had losses that prevented further drilling.  Performed second EZ Squeeze across entire open hole section and again had losses that prevented drilling ahead.  Set two expandable liners, the second of which was successfully set at 6,162? MD.  Directionally drilled with 5-1/2? x 6-1/2? BHA to TD of 7,230' MD.  Ran and cemented 5" liner due to the smaller hole restriction.  Circulated 12.3 ppg SBM in the hole.  ND BOPE and installed dry hole tree and tested to 1,000 psi.  Skidded rig to slot 6 for A-1ST.

7/6/2008: 9-5/8" casing was cut and pulled using the mechanical method at 47' (BML).  (This was conducted during Temporary Abandonment Operations and was provided for on the Accepted WAR for week ending 20080712 and on the Accpeted EOR's Temporary Abandonment Schematic dated 20080728.

11/1/2008: 13-3/8" casing was cut and pulled using the mechanical method at 17' (BML).

11/4/2008:  The 20" - 20" X 30" XO was cut and pulled using the mechanical method at 15' (BML).

Stone Energy successfully performed zone change operations on EI 243, OCS-G-02899, Well D-1ST to produce the "OW Upper" Sand.  Operations began on October 1, 2009 and were completed on October 6, 2009.  The previous producing interval, the "OW Lower" Sand, perfs 12962' - 12982' MD, was isolated by setting a BP @ 12825' and dumping 18' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12807'.  The "OW Upper" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 12770' - 12800'.

HIA572 Well No. C022 was temporarily abandoned on 05/27/07 with casings to be cut and pulled a minimum of 15' BML at time of platform removal.  Due to well bubbling, Apache requested approval to drill out existing cement plug/retainer and squeeze cement to stop bubbling.  Well C022 bubbling has been corrected and remains in TA status.

The GC825-16 wellbore was drilled to 7,700 ft MD (approximately 700 ft below TOS) and the 22in surface casing was run and cemented to ML. The well was temporarily abandoned for future drilling and completion operations.

On 6/26/2008 to 6/30/2008, LLOG Exploration Offshore, Inc. replaced the gas lift dummies in the long string with live gas lift valves at 8109'WLM, 7508'WLM, 6906'WLM, 6274'WLM, 5524'WLM, 4412'WLM, 3059'WLM and 1645'WLM.

Due to the fact that this well was classified as P&A?d by a previous operator in 1983 when the well was actually TA?d, McMoRan cannot change the P&A date to truly reflect the correct P&A date.  The B008 well was actually P&A?d (all casings removed 16-ft BML) on 08/05/2010.

MC 28 #A35 drilled to depth of 13,200' MD / 7077' TVD.  Inadvertent Bypass while washing in hole at 8,513' MD / 5,523' TVD. No hydrocarbons in open hole. No access to open hole due to cuttings debris.

The wells will remain in TA status until such time as the platform is no longer needed and ready for removal.  SPN, as lease holder also retains the final plugging and abandonment liability for the A structure and wells. (Note: When well is PA'd, a surface plug will be set and all casings will be cut at least 15' BML.)

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the SS 93 #8ST1 well to produce the "M-11" Sd. The previous completion, the "M-12" sd, was abandoned by sqeezing cement into the existing perfs, leaving the ETOC at 14,700' MD. The "M-11" sd was then exposed to production by perforating the intervals of 14,432'-14,457' & 14,470'-14,498' MD. Operations began on 08-25-10 and were completed on 09-05-10.

Please note 7-5/8" csg, 10-3/4" csg, 20" drive pipe and 60" caisson have been cut & pulled. It was discovered on 3/24/14 that the #9 well was removed prior to not setting the annular plug as per the approved RPM dated 07/23/14.

Remaining casings were pulled during this operation.  This well was originally plugged & abandoned in 1998 by Conoco.  GOM went in and cut these wells @ 20' BML in February 2012 and returned to pull the remaining csgs during the platform abandonment operations.

Well was TA'ed on 07/31/2009.  This operation was to mill out and reset a surface cement plug but the procedure was unable to be completed; Fieldwood will return in Spring 2016 to complete operations.  The well status date is unable to be changed.

The objective was to run diagnostic tools to identify tubing source of the casing pressure and make repairs to mitigate the sustained casing
pressure.

Operations took place 8/8/2021 through 3/3/2022. Due to indication of parted tubing, we moved off of the well on 3/3/2022.  A deep positive plug remains in the well, and the well is secured and in plug status.  Casing pressure is successfully remediated.  A casing diagnostic was performed on 3/4/2022 showing casing pressure bleeding to 0 psi in 1-1/2 hours.

Hydro pulled the tubing and ran and set a new packer to correct the casing pressure problem with the tubing/casing annulus. There is no longer applied pressure and nitrogen on the tbg/csg annulus. The completion fluid is an 18.2 PPG WBM.

Operations to temporarily abandon the well were completed on 06/09/2025.
*note eWell will not allow for a change in the TA date as the well was previously listed "TA" on 11/18/2010 due to zonal isolation; this operation was to complete TA through the surface plug.

Stone unsuccessfully performed zone change operations on EW 306, OCS-G-07917, Well A6ST2.  Operations began on March 24, 2009 and ended on June 29, 2009.  The "LA" Sand, perfs 11173' - 11188' & 11204' - 11231' & 11204' - 11245' MD, was isolated by setting a cmt plug from 11073' - 11245' MD.  A tubing punch, 10450' - 10460' MD, was completed to expose the "KS" Sand to production and flow the well through the standing valve @ 10517'; however, Stone was unable to establish production from the well due to the fish in the hole @ 10507' MD.

Slight intermittent bubbles were observed emanating from the annuli.   A slip on intervention well cap was installed. Micro-Matrix Cement was injected to stop bubbling. No bubbles observed.

Please note: The 30" and 13 3/8" casings / conductors were cut at 162' AML.
